name: LpdFi sizes an interest-bearing principal from the LPD spot pair price
summary: LpdFi.buy(uAmount) books an order's USD value from Lpd.price(), the LPD/USDC Pancake pair's spot reserve ratio, and pays 0.5% of it per day in USDC by removing protocol-owned LP. The attacker flash-pumped LPD, bought an order valued at a hugely inflated USD amount just before the daily rollover, dumped, and claimed a day's interest one block later.
notes: Anchored on the setup tx that bought the inflated order (the first execution of the defect); the claim one block later, after the daily issue rolled over, is the campaign tx that took the USDC.

Loss is the pair's net USDC outflow in the claim: the USDC leg of LpdFi's burned Cake-LP minus the USDC the attacker donated to the pair just before, which it took back. The LPD leg stayed with LpdFi.
